meta.name: baoyu-post-to-wechat
meta.description: Posts content to WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) via API or Chrome CDP. Supports article posting (文章) with HTML, markdown, or plain text input, and image-text posting (贴图, formerly 图文) with multiple images. Markdown article workflows default to converting ordinary external links into bottom citations for WeChat-friendly output. Use when user mentions "发布公众号", "post to wechat", "微信公众号", or "贴图/图文/文章".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容自动发布到微信公众号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将文章或图文发布到微信公众号
copy.tagline_en: Automatically publish content to WeChat Official Account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to post articles or images to WeChat Official Account

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 帮你把内容发布到微信公众号草稿箱:可发文章(支持 HTML、Markdown、纯文本)或贴图(最多 9 张图),走 API 或 Chrome 浏览器两种方式,Markdown 的外链默认转成文末引用。
howto.when: 当你提到「发布公众号」「post to wechat」「微信公众号」等关键词,或要求发贴图/图文/文章时触发。

say.note: 走发布流程,选方式后存为草稿

say.note: 改用浏览器发布并指定主题

say.text: 把这些图发成贴图,标题写「周末随拍」
say.note: 按贴图方式发布,最多 9 张图

howto.what_en: Installs so Claude can post to your WeChat Official Account: articles (HTML, Markdown, or plain text) or image-text posts with up to 9 images, via API or Chrome; Markdown external links become bottom citations by default.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "发布公众号", "post to wechat", or "微信公众号", or ask to publish 贴图/图文/文章.

say_en.text: Post content.md to my WeChat Official Account
say_en.note: Runs the publish flow, saves a draft

say_en.text: Publish this article via browser with the grace theme
say_en.note: Switches to browser publishing and theme

say_en.text: Post these images as an image-text post titled 周末随拍
say_en.note: Publishes as image-text, up to 9 images
